desc: Generic unbranded pool pump on a clean exterior equipment pad, with white PVC suction and return lines, accessible unions and isolation valves, plus a closed gray disconnect enclosure at a screened Florida pool.
reuse_notes: Use for pool-pump replacement, outdoor pool-equipment inspection, plumbing-union context, pool service planning, and screened-lanai articles.
